solar_storm.calm.narration.1: Time for our radiation check, Commander! Our mission uses NASA’s recorded observations.
solar_storm.calm.narration.2: In our story, the detector is clicking slowly. Let’s check our shield before we need it.
solar_storm.calm.dialogue.kai: Our mission starts with a calm solar setting. A check never hurts.
solar_storm.calm.dialogue.mei: Radiation is invisible, so we measure it.
solar_storm.calm.dialogue.thiri: Your mission uses a calm solar setting. Keep up the good work, Commander!
solar_storm.calm.question: How do we use a quiet day?
solar_storm.calm.A.label: Run the full shield check
solar_storm.calm.A.after: We checked every shield panel. It used a little power, and now we are better protected.
solar_storm.calm.B.label: Quick safety drill, research pauses
solar_storm.calm.B.after: Practice makes us ready. Research waited a little, and we learned the safety steps.
solar_storm.calm.C.label: Skip the check and keep working
solar_storm.calm.C.after: We got extra science, but we missed a safety check. Our game’s protection meter went down a little.
solar_storm.calm.classroom: Why check protection during a quiet setting?
solar_storm.active.narration.1: Beep! My radiation detector is clicking faster.
solar_storm.active.narration.2: NASA recorded increased solar activity in our mission’s observation window. In our story, we are preparing for a possible particle burst.
solar_storm.active.narration.3: It isn’t an emergency yet. Let’s get ready, Commander!
solar_storm.active.dialogue.kai: We can’t see radiation, but we can measure it. Let’s be careful.
solar_storm.active.dialogue.thiri: Our scientists are watching the Sun. Get your shield ready!
solar_storm.active.dialogue.robo: Her message was late, so we are already getting ready!
solar_storm.active.question: How do we get ready?
solar_storm.active.A.label: Boost the shield
solar_storm.active.A.after: The shield is ready! It used some power, but we are well prepared if the Sun gets busier.
solar_storm.active.B.label: Short shelter break, research pauses
solar_storm.active.B.after: We waited safely inside for a while. Research paused, but nobody is in danger.
solar_storm.active.C.label: Keep working and watch the meter
solar_storm.active.C.after: We got extra science, but the shield took a hit. Watching is smart, and so is getting ready early.
solar_storm.active.classroom: What can we do before a possible problem?
solar_storm.stormy.narration.1: Beep, beep! My radiation detector is clicking fast.
solar_storm.stormy.narration.2: In our story, a burst of fast, tiny particles from the Sun is reaching us. This is called a solar storm.
solar_storm.stormy.narration.3: Mars has very little protection, so we must act!
solar_storm.stormy.dialogue.kai: We can’t see radiation, but it can be harmful to astronauts.
solar_storm.stormy.dialogue.robo: Her message arrived after the storm started. That’s signal delay again!
solar_storm.stormy.question: How do we protect the crew?
solar_storm.stormy.A.label: Boost the shield
solar_storm.stormy.A.after: The shield is strong! It used a lot of power, but the crew stays well protected.
solar_storm.stormy.B.label: Everyone into the shelter, research pauses
solar_storm.stormy.B.after: Everyone is safe inside. We lose research time, but nobody is in danger.
solar_storm.stormy.C.label: Keep working and watch the meter
solar_storm.stormy.C.after: We got extra science, but the shield took a big hit. Next time, let’s weigh the risk.
solar_storm.stormy.classroom: How did you choose between protection and research?
solar_storm.cargo.shield_plating: We brought extra protection before launch. Our choices still matter.
